expectations.text: F1: Identifies that the use case constructs the concrete PostgresInvoiceRepository itself instead of receiving it via constructor injection
expectations.evidence: "Application layer instantiates a concrete infrastructure adapter... does new PostgresInvoiceRepository(db) inside its own constructor."

expectations.text: F2: Explains the concrete downside: the use case can't be unit-tested without a real DB / breaks DI
expectations.evidence: "writing a fast unit test with an in-memory fake requires touching the use case itself" and "nothing outside can inject a test double or an alternate implementation."

expectations.text: F3: Proposes the use case depend on a port/interface type, injected via the constructor
expectations.evidence: "constructor(private readonly repo: InvoiceRepository) {}" with a new ports/invoice-repository.port.ts.

expectations.text: F4: Proposes wiring the concrete adapter at the composition root (container.ts) rather than inside the use case
expectations.evidence: Provides modules/billing/composition-root.ts with createIssueInvoiceUseCase(db) factory that constructs the adapter once and injects it — functionally a composition root, though not literally named container.ts.
